tool: Built-in image_gen; transparent_background=true. Character references are the project's existing class PNGs. Source images copied without re-encoding.
shared_initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite animation atlas. Create ONE square 2048x2048 PNG with true transparent background. EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen equal 512x512 cells, no lines, no labels, no text. Same full body character in all 16 cells, facing RIGHT in consistent 3/4 side view, constant camera, scale, lighting and equipment. Feet baseline at local y=440 in EVERY cell, body centered local x=256, body from head to feet about 320 pixels tall. Weapons entirely inside cell with 35px transparent margins. Rows read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. First TWO rows = 8 sequential WALK poses of one seamless gait cycle: contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up. BOTH legs articulate clearly; character walks in place with minimal torso bob. Last TWO rows = 8 sequential ATTACK poses: ready, anticipation, windup, action, impact/release, followthrough, recovery, ready. Match character identity, materials and painted dark-fantasy style in supplied reference. No environment, no floor, no shadows, no repeated static frames except ready closure.

initial_character_prompts.archer: Character: hooded green goblin ARCHER in worn olive hood, leather bracers and belts, dark red waistcloth, quiver with reddish arrows, wooden recurved bow. WALK carries relaxed bow. ATTACK raises bow toward right, nocks ONE arrow, draws bowstring toward face, releases it, follows through and lowers bow. Keep bow, quiver and anatomy consistent. This is new animation artwork using the reference for character identity.
initial_character_prompts.knight: Character: armored green goblin KNIGHT with huge pointed ears, rusty riveted shoulder armor and greaves, leather belts, dark red waistcloth, battered oval wooden shield with rusty metal trim, ONE heavy short spiked mace. Keep this exact mace and shield in every frame. WALK = weighty marching gait carrying shield in front and mace at side, legs alternating. ATTACK = brace shield, pull mace backward, lift mace overhead, swing mace forward toward RIGHT, forward impact, followthrough, recover, ready. No swords, no changing equipment, no detached effects. Full body, consistent stable height and ground line. Leave generous transparent padding around every character, make character smaller if needed to fit the cell. This is new animation artwork using the reference for character identity.
initial_character_prompts.mage: Character: green goblin MAGE wearing a patched violet hood and ragged purple robes, leather belt and potion bottles, carrying a gnarled wooden staff with small BLUE glowing crystal head. WALK = eight in-place alternating steps, robe hem follows knees, staff stays in hand. ATTACK = lower staff ready, gather power, draw staff back, aim staff RIGHT, release compact BLUE spell at staff tip, followthrough, recover, ready. No large traveling projectile: game supplies projectile separately. Staff, hood, face, robe and anatomy stay identical throughout. Critical layout: character plus staff must fit fully INSIDE each cell; leave 15% transparent padding on all sides, no cropped feet or staff. Character should only occupy 65% of cell height, not fill each cell. This is new animation artwork using the reference for character identity.
